content.title: Safe and Green Development provides timelines for JV development portfolio
content.summary: Safe and Green Development (SGD) is excited to share its expected timeline for completion of its joint venture developments in Southern Texas. The timeline below is only considering the existing portfolio of joint ventures; however, the company will look to continue to expand its portfolio of joint ventures and initiate development on its existing joint venture properties in Oklahoma and Georgia. 2025: The company expects to complete all 35 homes in the Sugar Developments throughout 2025.
